answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique orbital slot and require every burn to carry a signed delta from its last attested state, so cloned identities diverge and fail peer verification. Peers cross-check maneuver histories through a prism of independent attestation channels, letting any ripple of duplicated ephemeris data propagate as a detectable collision warning. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
